## 💫 About Me

I'm a **product and data analyst**. Since 2022 I've standardized product KPIs with BI teams, led delivery of digital services as a product owner in telecom, and validated 7M+ records for a Databricks migration in aerospace.

My work starts with the business decision and the people who make it. At Telenor, my Power BI dashboards on adoption and usage informed roadmap priorities. I document assumptions, set acceptance criteria, and run UAT so the numbers hold up. Most of that work happens between teams: Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, BI, and data engineering.

I'm completing an **MSc in Business Analytics & Technology Management** at Concordia University, with a thesis on how AI can support quantitative research.

**Open to full-time roles in product, strategy, and analytics** in Toronto, Vancouver, or remote across Canada.

## Projects

- **Fraud Detection with GAN-Augmented RNNs** · Python, PyTorch · 2026\
  Only 0.17% of the 284,807 card transactions in Kaggle's dataset are fraud. I trained a WGAN-GP to generate synthetic fraud cases and rebalance the training set, then trained an LSTM on time-ordered transaction windows. It reached 0.83 PR-AUC against 0.72 for an XGBoost baseline. A cost-based threshold kept 91% recall while capping how many cases analysts must review.
- **VertekAI** · Product Strategist · PRDs, Figma · 2025\
  I owned product discovery for a healthcare analytics MVP. I wrote the PRDs, functional specifications, and wireframes, then acted as product owner: prioritizing the backlog and setting acceptance criteria through implementation and testing.
